svg.text: Three tracks, and the phases inside each
Phase 0 freezes the contracts first, so the three tracks can then run at the same time
real V2X messages on the wire
A track is a workstream owned by people and running for weeks; a phase is one stage inside it.
Tracks touch each other only through the frozen contracts — never through each other's code.
Source: plans/milestone1.md § 3 — Development Plan & Order of Implementation
